clips.title: The story
paras: Far Seer Mok'thardin seeks to harness the natural magic of Stranglethorn Vale for the benefit of the Horde. Building upon his previous rituals at Grom'gol Base Camp, he asks for sharp claws and a pristine feline fang to weave a powerful enchantment.

Within Grom'gol Base Camp, Far Seer Mok'thardin works to understand and bend the feral power of the wild to strengthen the Horde. Having seen success in his initial rites, he promises to craft a specialized enchanted relic for those willing to brave the dense underbrush and stalk the deadly predators prowling the surrounding territory.

The ritual demands eight claws taken from shadowmaw panthers and a pristine fang from a tigress. Mok'thardin notes that while these fierce felines wander across Stranglethorn Vale, a gathering of them prowls south-eastward, just past the river running by the Mizjah Ruins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The power of the jungle's magic must be realized and then harnessed by the Horde. My rituals have proven successful so far. I can cast very powerful enchantments. For you, brave adventurer, I shall make a special item indeed.
Bring to me some Shadowmaw Panther claws along with a Tigress fang. Not just any fang will do. It must be in pristine condition.
The beasts lurk throughout the jungle but you will find some close by, just across the river from Mizjah Ruins to the southeast.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your knowledge of the jungle is strong, friend. These specimens will be perfect. I will thank the spirits for sacrificing such fine beasts for the cause of the Horde.
